name: Brain gate — route new events against the open concerns
notes: Every 5 minutes: new user messages (every room, verbatim, any length) land in the brain inbox (brain_events in emi.db) and subconscious::gate routes each against the open concerns: bears on named concerns / new matter / none. Anything passed on triggers a noticer tick (cooldown-guarded, shared with answer capture), and the noticer reads the routed messages verbatim under the concern they bear on. Free when nothing new arrived. Added 2026-09-29 after the noticer never saw the owner say the dogs had their flea medication (its chat inputs were length-filtered samples).
